settings.headline: Answers grounded in your business evidence.
settings.intro: TraceKit Intelligence helps teams explore connected business records, investigate discrepancies, and ask better questions from within TraceKit.
settings.note: Examples on this website are illustrative; tool availability depends on product readiness and account permissions.

settings.heading: Ask better questions
settings.body: Move from a business question to the relevant source records, identities, and financial events.

settings.heading: Investigate attribution
settings.body: Explore how customer activity, affiliate traffic, purchases, and disputes relate, while separating attribution from causation.

settings.heading: Understand what is unresolved
settings.body: Preserve missing or unmatched records instead of presenting false certainty.

settings.heading: MCP as an extension
settings.body: Compatible external AI tools can access supported governed capabilities through MCP, subject to permissions and configuration.
